page.title: Detroit's parts bill: 25% at every crossing

page.title: The tariff bill on a $30,000 car
page.sub: Toyota pays 15% once on the sticker, Detroit pays 25% on its parts at six border crossings - $1,740 more for building it at home
page.source: DERIVED from $30,000 x 15% (USTR, the US-Japan finished-auto rate) and the hand-off's modelled stacked 25% parts duties (HTS 8708, CAR crossings)
